package.description: 以 Grok Build 为核心打造的桌面端 Agent。

en-US.description: A desktop agent built around Grok Build.
en-US.longDescription: Grox is a desktop agent built around xai-org/grok-build. It connects to a real Grok Build runtime through ACP (Agent Client Protocol), providing session resume, streaming reasoning, tool calls, code diffs, permission approval, structured Q&A, and usage statistics in a Tauri desktop window. It features a Deep Research background workflow (pausable, resumable, stoppable), Computer Use with full keyboard and mouse control on Windows (on by default), Browser Use headless screenshots, a parallel side-task workbench, Worktree/Git environment summaries, desktop notifications, a Chinese/English interface with light and dark themes, multi-account access (Grok OAuth, the official xAI API, and OpenAI-compatible services), and visual management of MCP, Skills, and Plugins extensions.

zh-CN.description: 以 Grok Build 为核心打造的桌面端 Agent。
zh-CN.longDescription: Grox 是以 xai-org/grok-build 为核心打造的桌面端 Agent，通过 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）连接真实的 Grok Build 运行时，在 Tauri 桌面窗口中提供会话恢复、流式思考、工具调用、代码差异、权限审批、结构化问答和用量统计。支持 Deep Research 后台工作流（可暂停、恢复或停止）、Computer Use（Windows 完整键鼠控制，默认开启）、Browser Use 无头截图、并行侧任务工作台、Worktree / Git 环境摘要、桌面通知、中英文界面与明暗主题，以及多账户接入（Grok OAuth、xAI 官方 API 与 OpenAI 兼容服务），并支持可视化添加、启用和移除 MCP、Skills、Plugins 扩展。
zh-CN.name: Grox
